focus: Replace scalar observation-rate privacy claims with source-bound channel witnesses, repair propagation consumers, and cut brittle worked-example and receipt-schema bulk
summary: Demotes four Boss Fight papers after proving that equal per-secret observation rates do not define an independent erasure channel. Adds an explicit cyclic-reveal mechanism with p=1/2 for every secret but one full bit of maximal leakage, repairs contact-correlation, path-selection, tier-composition, filter/odometer, and proof-carrying model-binding boundaries, then refactors Paper 17 and the receipt schema without adding a registry family.
changes: Observation-channel theorem: equal reveal marginals are not an erasure-channel certificate; the three-secret cyclic mechanism has actual maximal leakage 1 bit versus the scalar formula 0.321928094887 bits.
Exact recovery: the same mechanism permits uniform-prior recovery 2/3 versus the scalar-erasure prediction 5/12.
Contact dependence: with ten equal 0.1 marginals, any-hit may range from 0.1 to 1; 0.6513215599 is only the independent-contact scenario.
Proof-carrying boundary: arithmetic verdicts are now VALID-UNDER-MODEL(d_M) and require a source-bound channel-witness digest before any privacy interpretation.

Composition boundary: distinguishes odometers from prospective no-overshoot filters, requires secret-independent path selection or a joint-channel proof, and adds a one-bit tier-synergy counterexample.
Propagation repair: relabels evaluation Paper 2 and Paper 17 values as control-model sensitivity arithmetic with missing channel witnesses and publication_eligible=false.
Queue: moves Boss Fight A, B, B addendum, and C to Hold; Candidate 5, Published-ready 8, Hold 61, Published 7.
Audit/refactor: compacts the Paper 17 Hold note from 59,409 to 3,051 bytes and receipt-schema source from 28,200 to 16,839 bytes while retaining validator coverage.
Validator repair: resolves current queue notes by source_tex, preserves seven compressed payload pointers, and reaches a three-pass materialization fixed point.
Hostile review: adds seven Boss Fight vectors, bringing the executable total to 50; external packet expands to 19 tasks over 35 required surfaces and remains unsigned.
borrowed_patterns: A scalar telemetry rate is not a stochastic channel; privacy claims require the conditional output law or a proved wrapper that induces it.
A proof-carrying artifact can certify arithmetic while remaining scientifically invalid unless its model identity is source-bound.
Marginally safe views can leak jointly; composition needs a joint-law argument, not only per-tier numbers.
